label: Modal collapse: at every world, whatever proposition is true there is…, by Universal-instantiation
meaning: Let φ hold at w and v be accessible from w. A God-like x exists at w (C2). Being God-like is an essence of x at w (T2), and x has at w the property λ_. φ, so at v every God-like being has it, that is, φ holds at v if a God-like being exists at v; one does (T3). Uses the embedding's full comprehension: λ_. φ is a property.
